title: NPDev Canary
purpose: Fast Lane plan T1 canary: deliberately minimal, pipeline-complete fixture (2 concepts, 1 flow, 1 panel with 1 dataSource + 1 action, 1 procedure, 1 query with a real multi-clause WHERE) proving generate/build/boot/serve/flow/panel end to end. Frozen -- do not add features here.
walkthrough: GET /api/canary-panel/CanaryPanel (or the equivalent REST smoke path) and POST a CanaryTask through the CreateCanaryTask flow.
expectedOutcomes: OpenHighPriorityCanaryTasks only returns status='OPEN' AND priority>=2 rows -- proves the query WHERE actually filters (see LC-P0).
